clips.title: The story
paras: In the Redridge Mountains, rogues face a test set by Lucius at Alther's Mill. A locked footlocker holds the Token of Thievery, proof of skill recovered during their training.

In Lakeshire, Lucius tests promising rogues in the field. He hides the Token of Thievery in a locked footlocker among the ruins of Alther's Mill, where Blackrock orcs threaten the area. Recovering it tests whether an initiate can pick a lock under mortal danger. Success earns a Certificate of Thievery.
